theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+0.50%) and Materials (+0.37%) led the market today, while Communication Svcs (-1.56%) and Consumer Discretionary (-1.55%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged -0.87% versus -0.33% for defensives and -0.35% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.48%, Dow -0.67%, Nasdaq -0.43% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.07%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 0.63% to 14.22, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.58% to $4,487.40, crude oil was little changed at $90.60, and bitcoin slipped 2.19% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
